t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Fiitanfiit, Jamit I Mati aw u tuukaam man i manji, ni saafi. Tan emmi iŋje let waaf, aw u ŋoolenum wanoosan, ni maŋmaŋ mati ínje asúkateen, aw u kaanum erímbaan. Bajut emit yaakeen leejaataw, apakenem di katákasak, aw awbom di fukói.
